description:
Static OpenAI Administration API credentials.

One pydantic model per secret type the provider accepts. The docstring
documents the secret type; ``Field(description=...)`` documents each field;
required fields have no default, optional ones use a default. Prowler reads
this (via ``OpenAIProvider.get_credentials_schema``) to validate the stored
secret and to document its shape.

The two secret fields are ``organization_id`` and ``platform_api_key``.
``base_url`` is an optional non-secret override kept here so the credential
shape stays the single source of truth across the light (API/web) and the
runtime (worker) sides.

platform_api_key.description: OpenAI platform (Administration) API key used to read organization users and admin API keys
platform_api_key.title: Platform Api Key

base_url.description: OpenAI API base URL (defaults to https://api.openai.com/v1)
base_url.title: Base Url

title: OpenAIStaticCredentials
